name: Dirt Road Steel
old_description: I love this cross, it show me the faith and the power USA military has given us. Well crafted and beautiful color, couldn’t of asked for anything more meaningful to our heros
about:
Dirt Road Steel operates from Riverton, Wyoming, as a veteran-owned and locally operated business. The company emphasizes its American-made roots, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces hand-carved wooden flags and crosses, each made to order, along with upcoming metal art and apparel lines. Every item is described as 100% handmade and handcrafted in the USA, with no automation mentioned. The product range includes patriotic crosses (Old Glory, Thin Blue Line, Thin Red Line, Thin Green Line), wooden flags, and personalized signs such as the Wyoming Home Key Holder and monogrammed gifts.

Customers are primarily individuals seeking patriotic or faith-based gifts for military families, veterans, and first responders. Reviews cite purchases for Christmas, Mother's Day, and high school graduation gifts for enlistees, with buyers noting the items' symbolic value for Air Force special forces candidates, law enforcement, and firefighter households.

The company positions its veteran ownership and made-to-order craftsmanship as its core differentiators, highlighting free shipping on all orders and a commitment to 100% domestic production. The focus on unique character in each hand-carved piece and the personal connection to military service underpin its appeal.
